t: You're looking at a stained-glass panel showing the Crucifixion. The glass is credited to Gerhard Remisch, who made it and who lived from 1450 to 1520. That makes it a very old piece of craft, the work of one named maker rather than an anonymous workshop. I don't have more detail about the scene itself or how it came to be here, so take a moment to look at the colours and the lead lines, and see how the light moves through the glass.
